notes: Every node is a separate &Node{} on V's garbage-collected heap; leaves have nil children (unsafe { nil } field defaults).
V's default GC is Boehm (boehm_full_opt): -prod compiles in the bundled gc.c, a conservative, non-incremental mark-sweep collector that also has to mark the long-lived tree.
Recursive build and check; the result lines collect in a strings.Builder written to os.stdout() once.
v -prod (gcc -O3 -flto), statically linked against musl and stripped, running on a scratch image.
